versions.subject: feat: new linux rules related to GobRAT malware (#4272)
versions.detection:
selection_img:
    Image|endswith:
        - '/bash'
        - '/csh'
        - '/dash'
        - '/fish'
        - '/ksh'
        - '/sh'
        - '/zsh'
selection_flag:
    CommandLine|contains: ' -c '
selection_paths:
    # Note: Add more suspicious paths
    CommandLine|contains: '/tmp/'
condition: all of selection_*
